==Description==
'''Fat Bunny''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] regular track. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

When used, the player will start holding a large bunny.

This emote was obtainable at Level 34 of the Spring Frenzy Battle Pass regular track, which cost {{Bunz|1,190}} or {{Robux|298}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|19,030}} or {{Robux|3,400}}.
